<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope—a dominant monoisotopic peak at m/z ≈ 100, a +1 Da peak at ~5.6 % intensity, and rapidly diminishing higher‑mass peaks—the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution for a small organic molecule. No characteristic 2 Da doublet with ~3:1 (Cl) or ~1:1 (Br) intensity ratios is present, and the +2 Da intensity is far below what a single S, Cl, or Br isotope would give. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
